texts.zh:
我们的一位在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上工作的关键特工有点……迷恋上了当地的文明，并拒绝了许多已下达的任务。相反，这位过于独立的特工开始进行独立的异种学研究，并提交了许多请求，要求将其正式发布。

这些行为让[from.GetName]行动遭受到推延的风险，但我们必须承认，那个不守规矩的特工的工作事实上对我们相当有用。否认这一努力反而才会减缓我们的进展。
texts.en:
One of our key operatives working on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has become... enamored with the local civilization, and has been refusing many of their assigned tasks. Instead this overly-independent agent has taken up independent xenological study, and has submitted numerous requests to make this a formal posting.

Although these actions put Operation [from.GetName] at risk of delay, we must admit that the unruly operative's work has already proven rather useful to us. Denying this effort will slow our progress.

label.zh: 这种独创精神值得赞扬！
label.en: Such initiative is to be commended!
